summary.text: Jukai is a major green-aligned ancient forest on Kamigawa of huge cedars, home to many kami, orochi and kitsune.

bio.text: During the Kami War the orochi refused to fight the nature spirits, and when Towashi's construction destroyed forest and enraged the kami they closed Jukai to everyone, including the orochi.
The Order of Jukai was established about 1,200 years after the Kami War.

Part of the forest was destroyed in the soratami invasion, and in the events of Betrayers and Saviors Toshi and Kobo went to Jukai, where orochi killed Kobo and Michiko and Kyodai later merged and defeated O-Kagachi there.

Towashi's growth later consumed the edges of Jukai and enclosed the grove of Boseiju, displacing forest kami, until the emperor brokered an agreement halting the growth and forbidding the felling of Boseiju.
Kaito met Tameshi in the forest, where Tameshi hid his laboratory, and in the Order of Jukai's clash with the Hyozan Reckoners the group escaped with the kami that became Kaito's companion Himoto.
Clear-cutting for Towashi made the forest hostile to outsiders, though a young monk displaced by Towashi built a shrine around a seed that became a kami and reclaimed a section of forest.

status.text: In the latest story Jukai remains a diminished forest hostile to outsiders after the clear-cutting for Towashi, with kami and the Order of Jukai defending it.
